LanguageData.DreamSlaveHierarchy.label: Dreamt about hierarchy
LanguageData.DreamSlaveHierarchy.description: I sat on a golden throne, eating a delicious meal. People worked around me. When I was done eating, I called to them and they turned. All of them had my face!
LanguageData.DreamSlaveHierarchy.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamSlaveServitude.label: Dreamt about servitude
LanguageData.DreamSlaveServitude.description: There was stone tablet hovering just above me, inscribed with the endless, demeaning tasks ahead of me and with the big plans my masters have. It didn't feel like those plans included me.
LanguageData.DreamSlaveServitude.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamSolitaryConfinement.label: Dreamt about solitary confinement
LanguageData.DreamSolitaryConfinement.description: I dreamt of all my friends leaving me, one by one. In the end, it was only me, locked in this dark hole, forever.
